ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a signal flow graph. The input on the left is X_1(s), the input at the upper middle is X_2(s), and the output on the right is Y(s). The main channel from left to right has gains 1, G_1, and G_2 in sequence; X_2(s) is injected at the node between G_1 and G_2. The figure also draws two feedback branches with gain -1: one forms a closed loop with the G_1 section, and the other forms a closed loop jointly with the G_1 and G_2 sections. Reasoning: According to the problem, set X_1(s)=0, and only consider the transfer from the node where X_2(s) is injected to Y(s). This path has only one forward path, with path gain P=G_2. The loop gains are L_1=-G_1 and L_2=-G_1G_2. The two loops touch each other, and both touch the forward path from X_2 to Y, so there are no product terms of non-touching loops; in Mason's formula, Δ=1-(L_1+L_2)=1-(-G_1-G_1G_2)=1+G_1+G_1G_2=1+G_1(1+G_2). The cofactor of this forward path is Δ_path=1. Therefore the transfer function is Y(s)/X_2(s)|_{X_1(s)=0}=PΔ_path/Δ=G_2/[1+G_1(1+G_2)].

推理：令左端节点变量为 a，G1 前节点变量为 b，X2 与 G1 输出汇合处节点变量为 c，输出侧节点变量为 y。要求 X1(s)=0 时 Y(s)/X2(s)。由于 X1=0，左端节点只接收来自 c 的 -1 支路，所以 a = -c。G1 前节点接收来自 a 的 unity 支路以及来自输出侧节点 y 的 -1 支路，所以 b = a - y。中间节点 c 接收外部输入 X2 和 G1 b，所以 c = X2 + G1 b。输出侧节点满足 y = G2 c。代入 a=-c 和 y=G2 c 得 b = -c - G2 c = -(1+G2)c。因此 c = X2 + G1[-(1+G2)c] = X2 - G1(1+G2)c。整理得 [1 + G1(1+G2)]c = X2，所以 c/X2 = 1/[1 + G1(1+G2)]。又 y = G2 c，因此 Y(s)/X2(s)|_{X1(s)=0} = G2/[1 + G1(1+G2)]。
